name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 16 times in 5 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 32 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2025-10-18, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.75 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
